```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),       # input pair gm/Id (weak inversion for efficiency)
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.8, 4.0),          # input pair L (gain, flicker noise)
    "gmidp": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),        # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),          # PMOS load L
    "itail": (7.5e-6, 6.0e-6, 8.0e-6), # tail current (power-limited)
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),          # tail / reference mirror L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it = p["itail"]
    i1 = it / 2.0

    # devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.35)          # input pair
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=m1.vgs if False else 0.75)  # mirror load
    mref = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)                     # reference diode
    mt = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], it, vds=0.35)                         # tail (same gm/Id, L)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp drives the side whose drain is the output -> non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cx = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    fz2 = 2 * fp2
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz2))
    power = vdd * (iref + it)
    slew = it / cout
    cmrr = a0 * 2 * m3.gm / max(mt.gds, 1e-12)
    psrr = a0  # mirror-load 5T: supply gain ~ 1 at output for low freq
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 4.6 * tau + 0.3 / max(slew, 1)
    # thermal noise only (flicker added by simulation)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    swing = (vdd - m3.vdsat - 0.05) - (0.9 - m1.vgs + m1.vdsat + 0.05)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "power": power,
        "slew": slew,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(psrr),
        "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": vn_th * 5,   # rough allowance for 1/f at 1 kHz
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
